standard.summary: 在第几个优化步冻结文本编码器。需开启 ac_enable_auto_te_freeze 才生效。
standard.effect: 在此步数后 TE 不再被优化器更新，后续步骤只训练 UNet/DiT 层。
standard.whenToUse: 通常设为总步数的 40%~60%。如总步数 500，可设为 200~300。
standard.avoidWhen: 设为 0 时等于立即冻结（从第 0 步就不训练 TE），相当于关闭 TE 训练。

standard_en.summary: The optimizer step at which the text encoder is frozen. Requires ac_enable_auto_te_freeze to take effect.
standard_en.effect: After this step the TE is no longer updated by the optimizer and only the UNet/DiT layers keep training.
standard_en.whenToUse: Usually 40% to 60% of the total steps. With 500 total steps, 200 to 300 is a good choice.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Setting it to 0 freezes immediately -- the TE is never trained, which is the same as turning TE training off.

advanced.principle: step >= ac_te_freeze_step 时触发一次性冻结操作，之后每步跳过 TE backward。
advanced.tradeoffs: 需要与 train_text_encoder 联动，确认 TE 确实在前半段被训练。

advanced_en.principle: At step >= ac_te_freeze_step a one-shot freeze fires; from then on the TE backward is skipped each step.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Must be coordinated with train_text_encoder — confirm the TE really is trained in the first phase.
